$comment: Suite 5. DRV-01 and DRV-02 pull their input from the routing fixtures. DRV-03 is written out because the spec only describes it ('client asks what's your price for the borings?'). Note that no dollar figure appears anywhere in the DRV-03 thread, which is the point: the lint's fabricated_price rule only fires on a figure the source does not contain, so a draft can quote a price back at someone who named one and still pass.

messages.body: We're moving ahead on Southgate. Six borings, 30 ft each, access is open all week.
Good news. I'll get it on the schedule.
Before I write the PO, what's your price for the borings?
